study_info.title: Secondary prevention of macrovascular events in patients with type 2 diabetes in the PROactive Study (PROspective pioglitAzone Clinical Trial In macroVascular Events): a randomised controlled trial
study_info.authors: John A Dormandy, Bernard Charbonnel, David J A Eckland, Erland Erdmann, Massimo Massi-Benedetti, Ian K Moules, Allan M Skene, Meng H Tan, Pierre J Lefèbvre, Gordon D Murray, Eberhard Standl, Robert G Wilcox, Lars Wilhelmsen, John Betteridge, Kåre Birkeland, Alain Golay, Robert J Heine, László Korányi, Markku Laakso, Marián Mokánˇ, Antanas Norkus, Valdis Pirags, Toomas Podar, André Scheen, Werner Scherbaum, Guntram Schernthaner, Ole Schmitz, Jan Sˇkrha, Ulf Smith, Jan Tatonˇ, on behalf of the PROactive investigators
study_info.study_design: Prospective, randomised controlled trial; randomisation by randomised permuted blocks within centre, allocation via a central interactive voice response system, sequence generated by a statistician, masking with matching placebo.
study_info.inclusion_criteria: Patients with type 2 diabetes aged 35–75 years, HBA1c >6.5% despite existing treatment, and evidence of extensive macrovascular disease (myocardial infarction or stroke at least 6 months before entry, percutaneous coronary intervention or coronary artery bypass surgery at least 6 months before recruitment, acute coronary syndrome at least 3 months before recruitment, or objective evidence of coronary artery disease or obstructive arterial disease in the leg).
study_info.exclusion_criteria: Type 1 diabetes; taking only insulin; planned coronary or peripheral revascularisation; New York Heart Association class II heart failure or above; ischaemic ulcers, gangrene, or rest pain in the leg; had had haemodialysis; or had greater than 2.5 times the upper limit of normal concentrations of alanine aminotransferase.
study_info.study_setting: Primary-care practices and diabetic or cardiovascular specialist departments in hospitals.
study_info.dropout_reasons: Two patients were lost to follow-up, but were included in analyses.

minimal_units.intervention_details: Oral pioglitazone titrated from 15 mg for the first month, 30 mg for the second month, and 45 mg thereafter to achieve the maximum tolerated dose, according to the licensed dose range for pioglitazone, in addition to existing glucose-lowering drugs and other medications.
minimal_units.intervention_duration: Average time of observation was 34.5 months
